def changed_files_against(base: str) -> list[str]:
    out = subprocess.run(  # nosec B607 — fixed argv; git resolved from PATH like every repo tool
        [
            "git",
            "diff",
            "--name-only",
            "--no-renames",
            "--diff-filter=AMD",
            f"{base}...HEAD",
        ],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        cwd=ROOT,
    ).stdout
    return [line for line in out.splitlines() if line]
